# Add Health Pool To Player

Source: [6164](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/6164); edited 2025-06-14. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Add Health Pool To Player](../../api/actions/add-health-pool-to-player.md).

<a id="wiki-6164-n1"></a>

- A player may have at most 16 pools of each health type, counting base and ability-granted pools.

<a id="wiki-6164-n2"></a>

- Save Last Created Health Pool for later reference.

<a id="wiki-6164-n3"></a>

- Nonrecoverable pools shrink and disappear as damaged; Max Health reevaluates every frame only when both Recoverable and Reevaluation are true.

Source limitations:

- Player property incorrectly describes movement collision; Health Type prose mentions only armor/shields while description includes Health.
